messages:
Diego (sales): Quick thread  WorkflowBank asked if we can override hosted API per-token rates for a 4-week technical pilot. They want Tier1 pricing but no min, no prepayment. Thoughts?
Rina SE: Are they doing synchronous chat or heavy embeddings? Need token distribution.
Diego (sales): Primarily chat with some reranking; expect bursts up to 12M tokens/week, avg ~3M. Streaming required.
Toby (acct exec): We can grant a temporary rate override but only with a hard $ cap and an expiry. No ratecard edits.
Harper Finance: Agree. Provide margin delta and set exposure limit. Recommend capped credit $15k + auto-throttle when exhausted.
Diego (sales): Customer pushed back on caps, says pilot needs realistic volume. They offered to sign a conversion clause.
Legal: If we do this, SOW must include trial period, data handling (retention <= 30d), IP allowlist, and explicit no-SLA clause. Also need liability cap.
Toby (acct exec): Proposed resolution: 28-day Tier1 override via routing flag, $20k cap, customer signs SOW with conversion KPI and $3k refundable deposit. Approve?
Harper Finance: I can approve $20k cap with deposit + conversion KPI documented. Need expected token shape to compute worst-case.
Rina SE: We can implement override plus webhook alerts at 60/80/95% of cap. Config sample: routing.customer=workflowbank; price_override=0.00045; cap_usd=20000; ttl=28d.
DealDeskBot: Created ticket DD-423 assigned to @Harper Finance. Status: awaiting deposit + SOW.
Diego (sales): I'll get deposit and KPI from them today and attach to DD-423. Thanks everyone.
